name: geocodePlace
description: Cartociudad geocoder (official Spanish geographic geocoder). Use q='Madrid' to get candidates with find URLs. Show as clickable DIV list. When user picks one, they send 'ADD LAYER: url | name'. Call addLayer(type='GEOJSON', url=url, name=name, fit=true). Do NOT call this tool again.

q.description: Free text search query: address, street name, place name, municipality, postal code, or reference cadastral. Examples: 'Calle Mayor 5, Madrid', 'Plaza España 1, Sevilla', 'Madrid', '28001'. When using id+type this should be the address string (e.g. 'Madrid, Madrid').

id.description: Specific entity ID from a previous candidates search (optional). Used together with 'type' for precise geocoding.

type.description: Entity type when using specific id (optional): 'callejero', 'portal', 'carreteras', 'municipio', 'provincia', 'poblacion', 'toponimo', 'refcatastral'

portal.description: Portal or kilometre point number when using specific id+type (optional)
